discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 to packets 254/278 (Loungefly 2021), keys reused; 255/279/260/284 checked (no overlap with new keys). 30 standard searches, snippets only. Pack holds released: Dumbo Circus 4pc (MickeyBlog+DPB+HT name all four), WALL-E Earth Day (per-pin descriptions), Snow White 4pc (BoxLunch per-pin sizes; set-level identity hold). Kept: Peter Pan, Hula, SW Chibi, Villains, Dwarfs, Donuts, Profile designs, Dress, Princess Books set-level, PP signs names, PBTI structure, NBC advent names. Resolved: Princess Profile maker = Loungefly. New: Dumbo Circus blind box (Mar 2021), BatB Portraits blind box + Fixtures 4pc (Jun 2021), Mickey & Minnie Snowglobe LE 600 (Dec 2021).
